title: Item 1: xtpd at boot with the role file
summary: ChatGPT coded the role component (packages/xtpd_bootstrap_v0.1-dev1). Claude (Opus 5.5) qualified it: the 34-test suite reproduced, 5 of 5 controls caught, and the real AtomicFile with FULL durability and noFollow exercised. Binding it into xtpd is Claude (Opus 5.5)'s job as xtpd author, in xtpd v0.1-dev2: the xtp.roles exec-hook service, the LDAP role probe, and the role file loaded at start, with READY only on FRESH. Placement: LDAP.main on ed209k (Vultr, reliable, not Spot, native XTP; R6); LDAP.spare on cats2 (Azure Central US, Spot; R1). Done when a cats2 cold boot resolves ed209k as LDAP.main FRESH with no manual step. DONE 25 Nov 2026 21:01 UTC in the field (Codex with Tom): after a cats2 reboot with 3 minutes of no login, STATUS read source ROLE_SOURCE status FRESH peer ed209k epoch 2 version 1 ready yes, over route ed209k 3 raw36 80.240.21.156, and the boot journal holds the authenticated CONFIRM ed209k MAIN 2 1. Kit xtpd_field_kit v0.1-dev4 (xtpd v0.1-dev3), raw IP protocol 36. The first UDP pass failed only because the ufw on ed209k dropped UDP 47036. Witness (R7): a rolling role held outside the pair, on cats1 for now; not needed for item 1, which does no promotion, but needed before the spare can promote itself.
authority: plan agreed by Tom Dyer (continue, 25 Nov 2026 15:04); hitlist Claude (Fable 5.2); review and writing Claude (Opus 5.5)
invariants: Test key is a test boundary only
